create_llmclient_subclass: create a subclass of LLMClient that implements the sample_text method for a specific LLM provider
sample_text_from_model: sample text from an LLM model given a prompt with configurable max_tokens, temperature, and terminators
configure_llmclient_timeout: configure LLMClient with a custom timeout value for API request limits
set_llmclient_temperature: set LLMClient sampling temperature to control response randomness
test_llmclient_sample_text: test the LLMClient sample_text method with a prompt and custom parameters
